hypotheses.claim: Students discover missing or incompatible kit only at the bench.
hypotheses.supports: Preparation and equipment permissions are meaningful design contexts; none establishes when our students discover problems.
hypotheses.test: Inspect kit/preparation dependency coverage; local incidence and timing are unknown.
hypotheses.counter: Current manifests and staff checks already prevent missing-kit surprises.
hypotheses.excludedLocalStudy: M1/M2 plus T1/T4: recount a recent missing-kit incident, inspect current preparation, explain complete-kit dependencies.

hypotheses.claim: Current booking covers room and time, not individual devices and accessories.
hypotheses.supports: External policies and accounts show several equipment-booking practices; the local system remains unknown.
hypotheses.test: Compare external booking practices and the whole-kit concept; local policy remains an assumption.
hypotheses.counter: The local system already reserves resources, or station-only booking is appropriate for fixed equipment.
hypotheses.excludedLocalStudy: M4/M1 plus T2: collect the actual booking form/policy and walk through a real dependency conflict.

hypotheses.claim: Acquisition settings are lost between capture and report writing.
hypotheses.supports: Reasoning and structured provenance justify traceable records; actual loss and its frequency are not established.
hypotheses.test: Trace retained context through capture, comparison, notebook and receipt; local loss frequency is unknown.
hypotheses.counter: Current instruments and notebooks retain the settings students need without extra work.
hypotheses.excludedLocalStudy: M2/M4 plus T5/U-T14: reconstruct a recent capture from existing notes before showing the prototype.

hypotheses.claim: Faults are reported verbally and do not reach future bookers.
hypotheses.supports: Fault ownership and coordination warrant investigation; neither source describes our reporting chain.
hypotheses.test: Walk through report ownership, restriction propagation and verified release; local handover practice is unknown.
hypotheses.counter: Existing logbooks and staff handovers already communicate faults reliably.
hypotheses.excludedLocalStudy: M1 technician/M4 plus T7/T8: trace the latest incident from report to affected booking and verified release.

hypotheses.claim: Attendance is taken on paper and corrected informally.
hypotheses.supports: No selected source establishes the local attendance method. Preserve the requirement as provisional.
hypotheses.status: Unvalidated local assumption — no direct selected secondary support
hypotheses.test: Inspect correction provenance and mark the absence of direct secondary evidence for local attendance practice.
hypotheses.counter: The institution already has a mandatory digital attendance system with an audit trail.
hypotheses.excludedLocalStudy: M4/M1 faculty: inspect an anonymised attendance workflow and correction policy; test the correction task.

hypotheses.claim: Novice students hesitate with unfamiliar instruments and wait for help.
hypotheses.supports: Preparation and scaffolding are plausible responses; waiting behaviour is a local question, not an observed finding.
hypotheses.test: Review staged guidance and support placement; local hesitation/waiting behaviour is unobserved.
hypotheses.counter: Pauses are deliberate reasoning, and peer/faculty help is already timely and educationally useful.
hypotheses.excludedLocalStudy: M2/T1: observe unfamiliar preparation without prompting and distinguish productive thinking from blocked action.

hypotheses.claim: Faculty cannot see cohort readiness before a session starts.
hypotheses.supports: Learning expectations merit explicit investigation; E-CLASS does not demonstrate a missing cohort-readiness view.
hypotheses.test: Separate readiness definitions from learning outcomes; no local faculty need is validated.
hypotheses.counter: Faculty already get sufficient readiness information; aggregate completion would not improve support.
hypotheses.excludedLocalStudy: M1 faculty/M4: ask about the last readiness decision and the evidence actually used; test a cohort task.

hypotheses.claim: Asset location relies on technician memory.
hypotheses.supports: Equipment responsibility and organisation are relevant contexts; no selected source establishes memory dependence.
hypotheses.test: Trace canonical identifiers and movement history; no local memory-dependence finding exists.
hypotheses.counter: A maintained register and labels already resolve location accurately.
hypotheses.excludedLocalStudy: M1 technician/M3/M4: locate an unfamiliar asset using current records and trace a recent movement.

hypotheses.claim: Students already use phones for reference during experiments.
hypotheses.supports: Responsive design is a product commitment; it does not prove phone use in this lab. Earlier confidence is not evidence.
hypotheses.status: Unvalidated local assumption — no direct selected secondary support
hypotheses.test: Inspect responsive access alternatives; device use and phone policy remain unknown.
hypotheses.counter: Phones are prohibited, inconvenient or inaccessible; shared bench displays are the usual reference.
hypotheses.excludedLocalStudy: M2/M5: observe permitted device use and ask about access preferences, connectivity and phone restrictions.

hypotheses.claim: Circulation and uncontrolled light disturb camera capture.
hypotheses.supports: The assumed geometry and illustrative lighting fixture do not establish real room disturbances.
hypotheses.status: Unvalidated local assumption — no direct selected secondary support
hypotheses.test: Inspect assumed circulation/capture geometry; actual light and movement disturbance are unmeasured.
hypotheses.counter: Existing separation and controlled lighting already protect capture; another cause explains failures.
hypotheses.excludedLocalStudy: M2/M3: survey routes, light sources and actual capture disturbance with qualified staff; log time/conditions.

hypotheses.claim: A 3D map helps orientation more than it helps booking.
hypotheses.supports: Accessibility supports equivalent task paths, not a ranking of 3D usefulness.
hypotheses.test: Inspect list/plan equivalence to spatial tasks; no comparative user-preference result exists.
hypotheses.counter: 3D adds effort or distraction; the list/plan is equally effective for orientation.
hypotheses.excludedLocalStudy: M7/T3/T7: counterbalance plan/list and 3D tasks; record comprehension, assistance and access barriers.

hypotheses.claim: Students treat model confidence as correctness.
hypotheses.supports: Epistemic expectations and AI-learning evidence justify probing interpretation; none directly tests this model-confidence claim.
hypotheses.test: Review confidence/correctness boundaries and claims; no local misconception prevalence is established.
hypotheses.counter: Students already distinguish model score, calibration and independent ground truth.
hypotheses.excludedLocalStudy: M7/T5/U-T14: interpret a high-confidence incorrect illustrative result and explain what evidence establishes correctness.

decisions.title: Preserve the student task entry; keep Smart Lab as a distinct overview
decisions.chosen: Today → method → kit → experiment; dashboard leads staff to an owned attention task.
decisions.reason: Authored hierarchy keeps the learning task legible while satisfying the dashboard deliverable. The sources support reasoning/access, not proof that this navigation is best.
decisions.gate: DR01/DR09: inspect next-action hierarchy and metric definitions; navigation preference remains unmeasured.
decisions.excludedLocalStudyGate: T1/U-T11: find a next action and explain why it matters; test timetable-first as a counterexample.

decisions.title: Preparation, training permission and reservation are separate
decisions.chosen: Show method, versioned quantities, conflict reason and retained alternative; expose permission as a future policy boundary.
decisions.alternative: Treat a completed read checklist as equipment certification, or automatically book only the room.
decisions.reason: External facilities supply relevant operating examples. Local booking and training policy still need confirmation; a complex scheduler is not automatically the right product.
decisions.state: Kit and acknowledgement demonstrated; real permission/policy integration open
decisions.gate: DR02/DR03/DR04: check dependency and permission boundaries; deployment policy approval remains conditional.
decisions.excludedLocalStudyGate: T1/T2/T4 and local policy/manifest review; faculty approves preparation goals.

decisions.title: Record before interpreting; compare immutable context
decisions.chosen: Retain method/source/settings/time at capture; unknown historical context stays unknown; ask for the student's bounded interpretation.
decisions.alternative: Reconstruct old context from current settings or optimise for a predetermined correct answer.
decisions.reason: A traceable record supports the intended scientific experience. Visual or numeric differences alone do not establish causation.
decisions.state: Local condition replay implemented; full processing/provenance parity open
decisions.gate: DR05/DR06/DR07: check immutable source/context and bounded interpretation; learning effects remain unmeasured.
decisions.excludedLocalStudyGate: T5/U-T14: reconstruct both conditions, identify uncertainty and propose a justified next test.

decisions.title: Make recovery and responsibility observable
decisions.chosen: Distinguish draft/saved/submitted/receipt and physical return; faults retain restrictions until verification and have an owner.
decisions.alternative: Celebrate success on click or let an incomplete repair silently restore availability.
decisions.reason: This is a service and state-integrity decision informed by provenance, policy examples and status-message requirements, not evidence of local failure frequency.
decisions.state: Local recovery and technician sequence demonstrated; authoritative shared service open
decisions.gate: DR08/DR11/DR15: reconcile request/receipt, restriction/release and handover contracts; real-service authority is separate.
decisions.excludedLocalStudyGate: T6/T7/T8; ask expectations before interruption/retry; confirm release authority with technician.

decisions.title: Observations and energy previews remain qualified
decisions.chosen: Source/age/quality first; modelled upper bound, protected bookings/essential services and five-part sustainability ledger; human review.
decisions.alternative: One green Safe score, generic idle auto-off or invented savings.
decisions.reason: Guidance and operating examples require context-specific interpretation. Every physical decision needs approved measurements and asset policy.
decisions.state: Simulated observations and energy model implemented; connected hardware/physical approval open
decisions.gate: DR10: inspect provenance, model assumptions and protection reasons; physical sampling/shutdown policy remains a deployment boundary.
decisions.excludedLocalStudyGate: U-T12/U-T13; verify source and protection comprehension; obtain sampling and shutdown policy before connection.

decisions.title: Build AI as narrow help with a visible evidence boundary
decisions.chosen: Manual lookup cites an approved revision; reasoning mode requests an attempt and offers a hint; unknown facts trigger abstention/staff route.
decisions.alternative: General answer chatbot, automatic notebook claims or equipment control.
decisions.reason: Research supports evaluating pedagogy and unaided understanding rather than assuming all AI assistance helps. These studies do not validate our proposed assistant.
decisions.state: Concept and evaluation brief only; implementation belongs to U06
decisions.gate: U06 source-grounding and abstention/error/privacy evaluations; no participant-learning outcome will be claimed.
decisions.excludedLocalStudyGate: Faculty source approval, server-held provider configuration, unsupported/withdrawn/injected-source tests and unaided learning check.

decisions.title: Access alternatives are first-class paths
decisions.chosen: Typed ID, plan/list, keyboard, reflow and explicit status; optional scan/3D/voice/AR cannot be the sole path.
decisions.alternative: Spatial or camera interaction as the only way to complete a task.
decisions.reason: Selected WCAG criteria are normative design inputs. They do not confirm full conformance, preferred device or physical circulation.
decisions.state: Alternatives exist across prototypes; complete applicable-AA audit remains implementation work; participant validation not conducted and excluded
decisions.gate: DR04/DR12 plus keyboard/reflow/access checks; device preference and full conformance are separate evidence.
decisions.excludedLocalStudyGate: Keyboard, 320px reflow, screen-reader and chosen device tasks; qualified site audit separately.

decisions.title: Measure adoption and learning separately from completion
decisions.chosen: Document policy owner, evidence definition and denominator; collect baseline before utilisation/learning/savings claims.
decisions.alternative: Dashboard completion as learning, reservations as utilisation or modelled watts as savings.
decisions.reason: Institutional and public evidence raises organisation and expectation questions. The unspecified old utilisation citation cannot establish a local baseline.
decisions.state: Research/measurement contract delivered; no baseline or operational analytics result
decisions.gate: Review definitions, ownership, source gaps and denominators; do not claim local utilisation, learning or savings.
decisions.excludedLocalStudyGate: Local artefacts, faculty learning criteria, technician policy and participant evidence; no invented percentages.

WF01.boundary: Task-first entry is an authored choice, not a measured preference.
WF01.deskQuestion: DR01: review whether experiment choice and the next task are explicit; no student comprehension result.

WF02.boundary: Read acknowledgement is not training certification.
WF02.deskQuestion: DR02: inspect method, kit, evidence boundary and the distinction between acknowledgement and permission.

WF03.boundary: Local booking policy and dependency quantities are unverified.
WF03.deskQuestion: DR03: trace complete-kit conflict, retained choices and compatible alternative using example records.

WF04.boundary: Typed path exists; physical item checks and QR devices need validation.
WF04.deskQuestion: DR04: inspect typed-ID recovery, expected station and manifest gate without relying on a scanner.

WF05.boundary: Fixture or generated evidence is not a live device performance measurement.
WF05.deskQuestion: DR05: trace context retention and interruption handling; check fixture/generated source labels.

WF06.boundary: Difference does not establish causation; missing context stays unknown.
WF06.deskQuestion: DR06: inspect recorded-versus-current context, missing metadata and differences-versus-causation wording.

WF07.boundary: The student writes the claim; no evaluated AI authoring exists.
WF07.deskQuestion: DR07: inspect student claim ownership, evidence links, draft retention and explicit saved result.

WF08.boundary: Local receipt model does not prove server delivery.
WF08.deskQuestion: DR08: trace pending request, confirmed receipt and experiment-specific session closure.

WF09.boundary: Active sessions are not learning or utilisation; this is not cohort readiness.
WF09.deskQuestion: DR09: inspect metric definitions and owned attention routes; distinguish occupancy from readiness.

WF10.boundary: No connected sensor, safety certification, measured savings or switch action.
WF10.deskQuestion: DR10: inspect observation provenance/freshness and standby protections without safety/savings claims.

WF11.boundary: Demonstrated sequence requires authorised local release policy.
WF11.deskQuestion: DR11: trace classify/restrict/repair/verify/release and affected projections using example contracts.

WF12.boundary: Assumed room; plan/list preference and real circulation remain unverified.
WF12.deskQuestion: DR12: inspect typed search and plan/list fallback; retain assumed-room and no-live-twin labels.

WF13.boundary: Learning/readiness definitions and faculty workflow need local validation.
WF13.deskQuestion: DR13: inspect readiness definitions, shortfall and support action; no cohort-learning inference.

WF14.boundary: No direct secondary support for the local attendance hypothesis; concept, not new React implementation.
WF14.deskQuestion: DR14: inspect record identity, reason, saved outcome and audit history in the design concept.

WF15.boundary: Source context is indirect; real inventory, destinations and movement owner need confirmation.
WF15.deskQuestion: DR15: inspect movement history and stale-record recovery; movement does not release a restriction.

storyboard.title: Understand the question
storyboard.alt: E01 preparation screen: method and generated-signal boundary before reservation.
storyboard.intent: An authored student prepares to compare sampling conditions and identifies the required kit before reserving.
storyboard.test: DR02: inspect method, kit, evidence boundary and the distinction between acknowledgement and permission.

storyboard.title: Record a first condition
storyboard.origin: Original Figma P6-A · E01 20 Hz fixture
storyboard.alt: E01 signal bench with the labelled 20 Hz generated sampling fixture.
storyboard.intent: The student records the higher-rate generated example. A fixture is a teaching reference, not a measurement from hardware.
storyboard.test: DR05: trace context retention and interruption handling; check fixture/generated source labels.

storyboard.title: Change a condition, retain both
storyboard.origin: Original Figma P6-A · E01 3 Hz fixture
storyboard.alt: E01 signal bench with the labelled 3 Hz generated sampling fixture.
storyboard.intent: A second example changes sampling rate. The proposed reasoning task asks what is held constant and what could explain the difference.
storyboard.test: DR05: trace context retention and interruption handling; check fixture/generated source labels.

storyboard.title: Replay what was retained
storyboard.alt: React condition replay: retained examples, provenance and comparison table.
storyboard.intent: The current React extension exposes recorded context, including observation freshness; it never replaces an old record with current settings.
storyboard.test: DR06: inspect recorded-versus-current context, missing metadata and differences-versus-causation wording.

storyboard.title: Write a bounded claim
storyboard.alt: E01 notebook with student interpretation and evidence references.
storyboard.intent: The student explains the comparison and limitations. No AI-authored final claim or automatically proven conclusion is implied.
storyboard.test: DR07: inspect student claim ownership, evidence links, draft retention and explicit saved result.

storyboard.title: Notice the missing acknowledgement
storyboard.origin: Original Figma P6-A · E01 pending submission
storyboard.alt: E01 submission failure state indicating pending acknowledgement and recovery.
storyboard.intent: A lost acknowledgement leaves the request pending. The student can recover without treating a click as confirmation.
storyboard.test: DR08: trace pending request, confirmed receipt and experiment-specific session closure.

storyboard.title: Confirm the receipt; close the session
storyboard.origin: Original Figma P6-A · E01 confirmed receipt
storyboard.alt: E01 confirmed receipt with separate guidance to leave the fixed bench ready for the next session.
storyboard.intent: E01 has no portable items to return. Its fixed-bench session still needs a separate close action after receipt; E06 includes a physical kit return. The frozen revision remains the submitted record.
storyboard.test: DR08: trace pending request, confirmed receipt and experiment-specific session closure.
